description: Change or stop a series. Required: recurrence_id. Optional: every (new cadence), at ("12:00" pins it to a time of day, empty string removes that again) plus timezone, active (false pauses — the open task stays, no new one follows), title, notes, priority, due_now (true makes the next task due immediately). Changing every or at recomputes the next due date straight away instead of letting the change take effect two ticks later. The result reports triggered_by, i.e. whether the agent behind this series is actually run by the server. Pausing does not delete the history.

at.description: Time of day to pin the series to, e.g. 12:00; empty string removes it

due_now.description: Make the next task due immediately

every.description: New cadence, e.g. hourly, daily, weekly, 2h, 90m or minutes (min 5)

name: update_recurring_todo
